reason: The role filters and interview prompts sound useful, but installing Docker and configuring providers feels like another project when I am trying to apply. I would stick to my current job-search setup until I could see a quick demo that proves the drafts use my actual projects accurately.
objection: I do not know how much setup is involved or whether the tailored material will stay faithful to my projects instead of making things up.
would_change_my_mind: A no-key demo with a sample profile, a setup walkthrough that takes under ten minutes, and clear evidence that drafts only use facts I approve.
